schema_check.notes: Canonical fields present; two-record target satisfied.

slot_match_check.notes: Family, publishing domain, 2 records, moderate difficulty, and policy-vs-guidance cue all match ZH-16.

gold_uniqueness_check.notes: R1 alone controls and supplies 250 words at both query times; R2 cannot determine a formal limit.

pilot_overlap_check.notes: The guidance-note family was frozen before execution. Candidate avoids turning guidance into a pseudo-policy or contradictory numeric statement, so it does not intensify the known over-selection failure mode after observation.
